title: Stable pass matching a memory segment
statement: Let $\mu':\mathbb N\to\mathbb Z$, $dst\in\mathbb N$, and let $\pi$ be a finite list of natural numbers; let $kd:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$. Suppose that for each index $j$ in $\pi$, the memory value at $dst$ plus the sorting position of $j$ by the key $kd(\pi[j])$ equals $\pi[j]$. Then there is a list $\pi'$ of the same length such that, at each such sorting position, $\pi'$ contains the corresponding original entry $\pi[j]$, and the memory segment beginning at $dst$ consists exactly of the entries of $\pi'$ converted to integers.
